solutions.explanation:
The product and power rules for logarithms turn the given equations into a simple linear system. First check that these rules apply: \(x^2y>0\) forces \(x\ne0\) and \(y>0\), and then \(xy^3>0\) forces \(x>0\).

Let \(u=\log x\) and \(v=\log y\). The equations become
\[
u+3v=1,\qquad 2u+v=1.
\]
Twice the first equation minus the second eliminates \(u\):
\[
5v=1.
\]
Thus \(v=\frac15\), and substituting into \(2u+v=1\) gives \(u=\frac25\). Therefore
\[
\log(xy)=\log x+\log y
=\frac25+\frac15=\boxed{\frac35},
\]
which is choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
solutions.title: Turn the logarithms into linear equations
